query: How do I publish a static documentation site behind a CDN with automatic TLS, cache invalidation and a rollback path?

requirements.text: Describes how to point a custom apex domain at the CDN edge.
Explains automatic TLS certificate issuance and renewal at the edge.
Documents cache invalidation / purge after a deploy.
Describes immutable build artifacts and atomic deploys.
Explains how to roll back to a previous deploy.
Covers cache-control and max-age headers for static assets.
Describes origin authentication between CDN and object storage.
Explains edge redirect and rewrite rules.
Covers access logs and basic request metrics.
Describes cost drivers: egress, requests and invalidations.
Explains the CI permissions needed for an automated deploy.
